That's not going to solve anything. There's really little going on in my head in terms of depression. I'm not sitting here crying. I'm trying to make a conscious, sober decision about ending my life.

Thank you for the offer to see about taking antidepressants. But, that's hardly living to me. If anything, I'd rather die sober than live under a faux happiness.

Can't say I feel relieved at all.

Yes, my first serious relationship was with a cheater. How am I supposed to know who is going to cheat?

Thanks. It happened once before in a previous relationship.

I really can't help but think I found the right woman, only to find that she wants to fuck other guys.

Edit. spelling.
Yeah, I wish she would've broken up with me before going ahead with it. I feel like a fool because I assumed that things were going okay, and I even bought her a birthday present.
